hook: Galaxies seen by JWST at z 9 to 15 suggest star formation fell slowly to z~17, then faster to z~20

readout.label: Median redshift when 20% of mass formed

summary: The authors build a model of bursty star formation histories, test it on simulated galaxies, and apply it to 400 JWST galaxies. They infer the galaxies' ages, finding only 28 of 218 formed 20% of their mass by z=15, with a median formation redshift of 16.9. Conclusions at z>15 are extrapolations from model fits, and the z=20 constraint rests on a single galaxy.
title: Tracing early galaxies back in time: implications for the dearth of galaxies beyond z~15
